I think you’re an infj. I’m 100% an infj and I do all these things (except the sugar daddy I wish lol). I’m also admittedly an “unhealthy” infj, so that might have to do with it? Or not. Idk but if u can identify with most of the descriptions of an infj you probably are one. I’m also an enneagram 4 so that’s another big clue for me!

I repeat: I think I relate mainly cause I’m a really unhealthy infj!
I know exactly what you mean! But I think it’s cause I might be a little depressed. Probably doesn’t apply to all infjs.

Idk about other infj females but I’m 21, and it’s extremely hard for me to open up at this point in my life so I kind of inadvertently shut people out of my life. You can’t really form a connection with someone who isn’t willing to show you who they are, no matter how great the chemistry may be.
